# WWD

> > WWD (Women's Wear Daily) is the leading fashion trade publication covering luxury fashion, footwear, beauty industry news, and celebrity style from major fashion weeks and global markets.

WWD delivers comprehensive coverage of the fashion and beauty industries, including runway reports from Paris and Milan Fashion Weeks, sneaker releases from Nike and other major brands, business news from companies like Estée Lauder and Jimmy Choo, and celebrity style spotlights featuring figures like Bella Hadid and Heidi Klum. The publication serves as an essential resource for fashion professionals tracking trends, market movements, and industry developments.

## Key Topics

- Paris Fashion Week
- Milan Fashion Week
- Fall 2026 Collections
- Chanel
- Prada
- Nike Sneaker Releases
- Celebrity Style
- Luxury Footwear Trends
- Beauty Industry News
- Limited Edition Releases
- Runway Trends
- Designer Collaborations
- Fashion Business
- Street Style
- Shoe Trends
